itens.trecho: Um sucesso comercial, de crítica e de merchandising… mas com uma história cliché. Quando saiu, este filme foi publicitado e vendido como se fosse pão quente. Era uma febre. Uma mania.
A commercial, critical and merchandising success... but with a cliché story. When it came out, this movie was publicized and sold like hotcakes. It was a fever. A mania.

So the shiny, red, "Lightning McQueen" is determined to make it to distant California to compete in the "Piston Cup". Along the way he stops off in the small town of "Radiator Springs" where he manages to tear up their road. His punishment?
